description: Primary discovery tool — search the HTTPayer Data Index for x402-enabled endpoints using natural language. Call this first for any data or API request that is NOT InvestBud-related (markets/crypto/wallets/portfolio). Returns ranked endpoints with pricing, input/output schemas, and payment options. Costs $0.01 per search.

max_price.description: Maximum price in USD to filter results (e.g., 0.05)

query.description: Natural language query (e.g., 'wallet balances on solana', 'twitter mentions')

name: search_endpoints
title: Search Endpoints
